data.narrative:
Vannevar Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $90M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage. Key private comparables include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), with a median valuation of $1.0B across the 7-company private sample.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $90M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $171M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks Vannevar against same-sector, same-stage comparables, producing a $1.0B implied valuation; the full peer range spans $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $145M to $1.1B, with a median of $586M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Vannevar's competitive positioning relative to better-capitalized peers and the relative weight of early-stage funding multiples versus established defense-tech market precedent. The stage-progression method anchors a conservative floor; peer medians suggest meaningfully higher value capture is achievable, though peers exhibit heterogeneous revenue profiles and growth trajectories not fully detailed here.
